propositions.name: ether_exists
propositions.statement: There is an ether, and bodies are moving through it or across it.
propositions.quote: the length of material bodies changes, according as they are moving through the ether or across it, by an amount depending on the square of the ratio of their velocity to that of light

propositions.name: bodies_move_through_ether
propositions.statement: Material bodies have a velocity of moving through the ether.
propositions.quote: the length of material bodies changes, according as they are moving through the ether or across it, by an amount depending on the square of the ratio of their velocity to that of light

propositions.name: through_versus_across_ether_matters
propositions.statement: The length changes according as bodies are moving through the ether or across it, so the two are not the same.
propositions.quote: the length of material bodies changes, according as they are moving through the ether or across it, by an amount depending on the square of the ratio of their velocity to that of light

propositions.name: length_of_bodies_changes
propositions.statement: The length of material bodies changes with their motion through the ether.
propositions.quote: I would suggest that almost the only hypothesis that can reconcile this opposition is that the length of material bodies changes

propositions.name: length_change_depends_on_v2c2
propositions.statement: The length of bodies changes by an amount depending on the square of the ratio of their velocity to that of light.
propositions.quote: by an amount depending on the square of the ratio of their velocity to that of light

propositions.name: velocity_of_light_exists
propositions.statement: There is a velocity of light, and the velocity of bodies has a ratio to it.
propositions.quote: by an amount depending on the square of the ratio of their velocity to that of light

propositions.name: electric_forces_affected_by_ether_motion
propositions.statement: Electric forces are affected by the motion of electrified bodies relative to the ether.
propositions.quote: We know that electric forces are affected by the motion of the electrified bodies relative to the ether

propositions.name: molecular_forces_like_electric_forces
propositions.statement: The molecular forces are affected by motion through the ether, as the electric forces are.
propositions.quote: it seems a not improbable supposition that the molecular forces are affected by the motion, and that the size of a body alters consequently

propositions.name: size_alters_from_molecular_forces
propositions.statement: The size of a body alters consequently when the molecular forces are affected by the motion.
propositions.quote: it seems a not improbable supposition that the molecular forces are affected by the motion, and that the size of a body alters consequently

propositions.name: opposition_is_to_be_reconciled
propositions.statement: The Michelson and Morley result and the other experiments are opposed, and this opposition is to be reconciled.
propositions.quote: Their result seems opposed to other experiments showing that the ether in the air can be carried along only to an inappreciable extent.

propositions.name: length_hypothesis_almost_only_reconciler
propositions.statement: Almost the only hypothesis that can reconcile this opposition is that the length of material bodies changes.
propositions.quote: I would suggest that almost the only hypothesis that can reconcile this opposition is that the length of material bodies changes

propositions.name: earth_has_orbital_velocity
propositions.statement: There is an orbital velocity of the earth.
propositions.quote: diurnal due to the rotation of the earth being added and subtracted from its orbital velocity

propositions.name: solar_system_has_motion
propositions.statement: There is a motion of the solar system.
propositions.quote: annual similarly for its orbital velocity and the motion of the solar system

propositions.name: rotation_added_subtracted_from_orbital
propositions.statement: The rotation of the earth is added and subtracted from its orbital velocity.
propositions.quote: diurnal due to the rotation of the earth being added and subtracted from its orbital velocity

propositions.name: orbital_and_solar_system_similarly_combine
propositions.statement: The orbital velocity of the earth and the motion of the solar system similarly combine, as the rotation and orbital velocity do.
propositions.quote: annual similarly for its orbital velocity and the motion of the solar system

propositions.name: earth_is_in_rotation
propositions.statement: There is rotation of the earth.
propositions.quote: diurnal due to the rotation of the earth being added and subtracted from its orbital velocity

propositions.name: diurnal_variation_from_rotation
propositions.statement: The diurnal variation of attraction is due to the rotation of the earth being added and subtracted from its orbital velocity.
propositions.quote: diurnal due to the rotation of the earth being added and subtracted from its orbital velocity

propositions.name: annual_variation_from_orbital_and_solar
propositions.statement: The annual variation of attraction is similarly due to the orbital velocity and the motion of the solar system.
propositions.quote: annual similarly for its orbital velocity and the motion of the solar system

propositions.name: attraction_varies_with_ether_motion
propositions.statement: The electrical attraction between permanently electrified bodies varies with their motion through the ether.
propositions.quote: to observe whether there is any diurnal and annual variation of attraction

propositions.name: quadrant_electrometer_can_observe_variation
propositions.statement: A very delicate quadrant electrometer can observe the diurnal and annual variation of attraction.
propositions.quote: It would be very important if secular experiments on electrical attractions between permanently electrified bodies, such as in a very delicate quadrant electrometer, were instituted in some of the equatorial parts of the earth

propositions.name: secular_experiments_capture_variations
propositions.statement: Secular experiments can observe whether there is any diurnal and annual variation of attraction.
propositions.quote: to observe whether there is any diurnal and annual variation of attraction

propositions.name: mm_experiment_can_decide_ether_carriage
propositions.statement: The Michelson and Morley experiment can decide how far the ether is carried along by the earth.
propositions.quote: Messrs. Michelson and Morley 's wonderfully delicate experiment attempting to decide the important question as to how far the ether is carried along by the earth

propositions.name: one_ether_across_experiments
propositions.statement: The ether in the Michelson and Morley experiment and the ether in the air of other experiments are the ether.
propositions.quote: Their result seems opposed to other experiments showing that the ether in the air can be carried along only to an inappreciable extent.

propositions.name: ratio_velocity_light_is_amount
propositions.statement: The ratio of the velocity of a body to that of light is an amount that the length change depends on.
propositions.quote: by an amount depending on the square of the ratio of their velocity to that of light

propositions.name: motion_is_relative_to_ether
propositions.statement: The motion of the electrified bodies is relative to the ether.
propositions.quote: We know that electric forces are affected by the motion of the electrified bodies relative to the ether

propositions.name: ether_carriage_is_a_definite_question
propositions.statement: There is an important question as to how far the ether is carried along by the earth.
propositions.quote: wonderfully delicate experiment attempting to decide the important question as to how far the ether is carried along by the earth

propositions.name: permanently_electrified_bodies_exist
propositions.statement: Bodies can be permanently electrified, and electrical attractions between them can be observed.
propositions.quote: secular experiments on electrical attractions between permanently electrified bodies, such as in a very delicate quadrant electrometer

propositions.name: air_experiments_are_reliable
propositions.statement: The other experiments showing that the ether in the air can be carried along only to an inappreciable extent are not to be opposed.
propositions.quote: Their result seems opposed to other experiments showing that the ether in the air can be carried along only to an inappreciable extent.

propositions.name: size_change_alters_attraction
propositions.statement: The alteration of the size of a body would be observed as a variation of attraction between electrified bodies.
propositions.quote: to observe whether there is any diurnal and annual variation of attraction

propositions.name: equatorial_parts_relevant
propositions.statement: The secular experiments would be instituted in some of the equatorial parts of the earth.
propositions.quote: It would be very important if secular experiments on electrical attractions between permanently electrified bodies, such as in a very delicate quadrant electrometer, were instituted in some of the equatorial parts of the earth
